name: FileOutput
description: Generate PDF or DOCX reports from RAG data, chat history, or web sources, and email them via Gmail

workflows.name: generate_report
workflows.description: Collect data from available sources and compile a structured PDF or DOCX report

required_params.name: report_topic
required_params.description: What should the report cover? Be as specific as possible.

optional_params.name: data_sources
optional_params.description: Where should I pull data from? Options: rag, chat_history, web, all (default: all)

optional_params.name: report_title
optional_params.description: What title should the report have?

optional_params.name: additional_instructions
optional_params.description: Any specific sections or details you want included?

workflows.name: email_report
workflows.description: Email the most recently generated report as an attachment via Gmail

required_params.name: recipient
required_params.description: Who should I send the report to? (name or email)

optional_params.name: message
optional_params.description: What message should accompany the report?
